_comment: Smoke-test config: points the production collector at the disposable bench database (sqldash_bench) provisioned by the ingest spike — it already holds the seeded registry.instances fleet (1000 rows -> localhost) AND a working DuckLake catalog at s3://sqldash-data-<acct>/sqldash-bench/. Use a small -InstanceIds subset so the test stays light. High data_inlining_row_limit keeps the test fully inlined in Postgres (no S3 PUTs).
